hypotheses.description: epistemic_accuracy increases above 0.6 by tick 2000, diverging from the null baseline (Exp-000, 0.6 at 500 ticks). If full governance is functioning correctly, accurate claims should accumulate at operationalised state while inaccurate claims face more reversions, producing accuracy above chance over sufficient time.

authority_concentration_gini continues to increase beyond the Exp-001 value of 0.226, consistent with authority gravity as a compounding mechanism that accumulates over time. Predicted value at tick 2000: > 0.4.
epistemic_stability_index remains at or near 1.0, confirming that full governance sustains stability over extended runs rather than degrading through authority gravity or other accumulation effects.
